limitations.title: Irregular Observation Frequency
limitations.description: ECOSTRESS observations depend on ISS orbital geometry. Overpass frequency is irregular and varies between seasons, making year-to-year comparisons sensitive to observation timing.
limitations.mitigation: Report observation counts alongside all summary values. Do not treat annual means as uniform time series.

limitations.title: 2024 ET and ESI: Low Confidence
limitations.description: Only 2 ECOSTRESS observations were acquired for the April–June 2024 window for ET and ESI products. This is insufficient to characterize seasonal conditions with confidence.
limitations.mitigation: Display LOW CONFIDENCE badge. Do not include 2024 ET/ESI in trend calculations. Annotate all figures clearly.

limitations.title: 2025: Partial Season
limitations.description: Data collection for 2025 is ongoing. All 2025 values are preliminary and based on 1–3 observations. The season has not yet been completed.
limitations.mitigation: Mark 2025 as 'partial season'. Do not compare 2025 to complete-season years without explicit caveat.

limitations.title: April–June Window Only
limitations.description: Analysis is restricted to the April–June phenological window. This is not the full growing season (which extends through August/September in alpine ecosystems). Signals may not represent peak-season vegetation conditions.
limitations.mitigation: Label consistently as 'April–June window' or 'AMJ'. Never describe as 'full growing season' or use JJA terminology.

limitations.title: 70m Nominal Resolution
limitations.description: ECOSTRESS has 70m nominal spatial resolution. The SNP encompasses heterogeneous terrain at scales finer than this. Results represent area-averaged signals and cannot resolve sub-pixel variation.
limitations.mitigation: Describe outputs as 'area mean' or 'spatially averaged'. Note that fine-scale ecological features are below instrument resolution.

limitations.title: Research Prototype
limitations.description: This analysis pipeline is a research prototype. Data processing, AOI masking, and quality filtering have not undergone formal peer review. Results should be treated as exploratory and require independent validation.
limitations.mitigation: Label all figures as 'research prototype'. Use cautious language: directional signal, requires validation, not confirmed trend.
